description_en: Queries the trend of API security API assets
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi describe-apisec-asset-trend --instance-id waf_v2_public_cn-ww00b06 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeApisecAssetTrend

parameters.help_en:
Instance ID of the WAF instance.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html to query instance ID of the current WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html查询当前WAF实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the hybrid cloud cluster.
This parameter is available only in hybrid cloud scenarios. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2849376.html to obtain hybrid cloud cluster information
parameters.help_zh:
混合云集群 ID。
只针对混合云场景，您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2849376.html获取混合云集群信息
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. The value is a UNIX timestamp (UTC). Unit: milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 查询开始时间，格式为Unix时间戳（UTC时间），单位为毫秒
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query. The value is a UNIX timestamp (UTC). Unit: milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间，格式为Unix时间戳（UTC时间），单位为毫秒
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id

Data.description_en: The list of API asset information

AssetCount.description_en: The total number of API assets

Timestamp.description_en: The time of the statistics. The value is a UNIX timestamp (UTC). Unit: seconds
Timestamp.description_zh: 统计的时间，格式为Unix时间戳（UTC时间），单位为秒
